title: COG: Confidence-aware Optimal Geometric Correspondence for Unsupervised Single-reference Novel Object Pose Estimation

layout.note: Left: a grid of three object columns by three lettered rows, with a thin rule and gear between rows (a) and (b); right: a pale-grey panel (d) with the transport matrices and a tall colour bar at the far edge.

lesson: Show a task by following the same few objects down aligned rows (inputs, intermediate output, final result), marked only by letters and a gear on a rule, and draw the formulation in a grey side panel as small matrices; carry one colour scale from the data through the matrices to a colour bar.
